<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Nexttag.Ai.Graph</id>
    <version>0.3.0</version>
    <authors>Jonathan Schenker</authors>
    <license type="file">LICENSE.txt</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://aka.ms/deprecateLicenseUrl</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/nexttag/Nexttag.Libs</projectUrl>
    <description>Orquestracao de agentes de IA em grafo de estado (estilo LangGraph) para .NET. Fachada estavel e idiomatica sobre o Microsoft Agent Framework Workflows: nos-funcao e nos-agente, arestas condicionais/ciclos, reducers por anotacao, checkpoint, human-in-the-loop e modelo visual (GraphView) para front-ends como React Flow. Sobre Microsoft.Extensions.AI.</description>
    <releaseNotes>0.2.0: human-in-the-loop (AddHumanNode + StreamAsync/RunAsync com onInterrupt) — pausa o grafo, carrega o estado pela pausa e dobra a decisao; emite GraphInterrupted. 0.1.0: grafo de agentes/nos (estilo LangGraph) como fachada estavel sobre o Microsoft Agent Framework Workflows: estado tipado com reducers por anotacao ([Reduce]), arestas condicionais e ciclos, no-funcao e no-agente (reuso de Nexttag.Ai.Agents), streaming de GraphEvent, GraphView para React Flow e checkpoint in-memory. O tipo do MAF nunca vaza na API publica.</releaseNotes>
    <copyright>Copyright (c) Nexttag. Todos os direitos reservados.</copyright>
    <tags>ai agents workflow langgraph graph orchestration llm</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/nexttag/Nexttag.Libs" commit="295e32d4781cd551bb2fd93c11f8e7747cbbe27a" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="Nexttag.Ai.Agents" version="1.3.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Agents.AI" version="1.17.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Agents.AI.Workflows" version="1.17.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
